hits: UnicodeGames — Free Browser Games Made of Characters
No paywalls, no pop-ups, no "watch an ad to continue". Just the games, the way they should be.

UnicodeGames strips the friction out of casual gaming. There is nothing between you and the game but a single click — and because every game is rendered from text characters, even the visuals download in an instant.
Browse the arcade and choose from puzzles, arcade classics, strategy duels and memory games.
Train your recall with bright, friendly matching games.

Unicode games are browser games whose entire visual presentation is built from Unicode characters — letters, numbers, box-drawing lines, mathematical symbols and playing-card glyphs — rather than from bitmap sprites or downloaded images. Because the "graphics" are just text, the games are tiny, load instantly, and look perfectly crisp on any screen at any zoom level.
UnicodeGames is a free arcade built entirely on this idea. We have remade beloved classics —

UnicodeGames is a free online arcade of classic games — like 2048, Minesweeper and Snake — that are drawn entirely with Unicode characters and symbols instead of image graphics. Every game runs instantly in your browser.
Why build games out of Unicode characters?
Text glyphs load instantly, stay crisp at any size and zoom, work on every device, and give the games a clean, retro-terminal charm. It also keeps each page tiny and fast.
Absolutely. Every game supports touch — swipe to move in Snake and 2048, tap cells in Minesweeper and the grid games — and the boards scale to your screen.
Play classic games rendered entirely with Unicode characters and symbols — 2048, Minesweeper, Snake, Tic-Tac-Toe and more. Free, no install, no account, runs instantly in your browser.
UnicodeGames is free, has no ads and never will. If it brightened a coffee break, you can return the favour.

Install the Post Formatter Chrome extension, select any text in the LinkedIn editor, and click the Bold button on the floating toolbar. Your text is instantly converted to Unicode bold characters that display as bold on LinkedIn, no special rendering needed.

A LinkedIn text formatter is a tool that lets you apply bold, italic, strikethrough, underline, and other text styles to your LinkedIn posts. Post Formatter is a Chrome extension that adds a floating toolbar directly inside the LinkedIn editor, supporting 30+ Unicode font styles.

Post Formatter offers 30+ Unicode font styles: bold, italic, bold italic, strikethrough, underline, monospace, script, fraktur, double-struck, small caps, bubble text, square text, full width, superscript, subscript, wide text, and more. All styles work on LinkedIn and other social platforms.
Which platforms does Post Formatter support?
Post Formatter works on LinkedIn, X (Twitter), Facebook, Threads, Bluesky, YouTube, and Pinterest. The inline formatting widget appears on any supported platform when you select text.
How does the LinkedIn post formatter work?

Post Formatter converts your regular text into Unicode characters that look like bold, italic, or other formatted text. Since these are actual Unicode characters (not HTML styling), they display correctly on LinkedIn and all social media platforms without any special rendering.

Yes. Post Formatter includes Smart Paste, which auto-converts bold, italic, strikethrough, underline, and lists from Google Docs, Microsoft Word, or Notion into Unicode equivalents when you paste into LinkedIn or any supported platform.
Does Post Formatter work on Edge and Brave?
Yes. Post Formatter is a Chromium-based extension, so it works on Google Chrome, Microsoft Edge, and Brave. Install it from the Chrome Web Store in any of these browsers.

Post Formatter Pro includes AI Proofread and AI Auto-Styling. You add your own OpenRouter API key in settings, pick any model OpenRouter supports, and the extension sends your text for grammar, spelling, and style suggestions. Edits are shown inline over your text so you can accept or reject each change. AI Auto-Styling takes plain text and automatically applies bold, italic, or bold italic to the phrases worth emphasizing.

AI proofreading and auto-styling are part of Post Formatter Pro, with a few free trials so you can try them first. AI runs on your own OpenRouter API key, so model usage is billed to your OpenRouter account at cost, Pro unlocks the feature along with the rest of the premium toolkit (30+ styles, multi-platform post preview, and Pro drafts).
Can I use Post Formatter in Chrome's side panel?

Yes. The extension opens in Chrome's side panel as a full-height editor with drafts, symbols, styles, and character limit tracking, useful for writing longer posts side-by-side with LinkedIn, X, or any other site.
